m13.text: Bazzle's workshop is a cluttered clock shop where Bazzle wakes to find that his clockwork creation has escaped again, and he finds hundreds of strange keys left in his shop.
He finds a crude brass clockwork arm made of melted keys and realizes the creature has learned its creator's trade and effectively become his apprentice.

He tries to dislodge the creature's chest key, but it winds itself and strikes him in the face, and on later mornings he finds a clockwork head and then his good arm severed and replaced with the metal one.
Bazzle realizes the creature only wanted to stop sharing a body with him, and it takes a cleaver and beheads him, setting its own head in his place and completing itself.
